author: Irasema Campbell
text: Highly recommend American Septic and Grease Retrieval for grease trap service. They’re always on time and never miss a scheduled visit — something we couldn’t count on with other companies we’ve used in the past. The crew is fast, professional, and thorough every single time. If you need a service you can actually rely on, this is the company. Great experience all around!

author: Tanya Chambers
text: This is a great company! They are reliable and do a wonderful job! Jacob is amazing and let's me know when he is coming to clean our grease trap and shows up! I highly recommend them!

author: Beverly Cuellar
text: We recently used American Septic and Grease Retrieval LLC and had a great experience. Their team was professional, responsive, and provided excellent customer service from start to finish. They were punctual, knowledgeable, and made the entire process smooth and stress-free. It’s clear they truly care about their customers and the quality of their work. I highly recommend them to anyone needing septic or grease retrieval services. Thank you again for the outstanding service!

author: Victoria Alvarado
text: I highly recommend giving ASGR a chance if you haven’t already. I’ve been doing business with them for the past 2 years, and they have never disappointed me. Their team is always reliable, responsive, and ready to help whenever needed. I’ve worked with other companies before, and honestly, the level of service and professionalism ASGR provides is unmatched.

author: Carlos Flores
text: Jacob is extremely polite and professional! He texted me when he was leaving his shop and got to my place in no time. It did not take him long to get the job done. He was also more affordable compared to others I had called. I highly recommend!
